observation.goal: Draft a formal weekly status email from provided bullet points.

key_steps.action: Draft formal email with blockers section

observation.output_description: A formal weekly status update email addressed to the manager.
constraints: Include Blockers section even if empty

response.name: draft_weekly_status_email
response.description: Drafts a formal weekly status email from provided bullet points.
response.prompt_template: Draft a formal weekly status email addressed to {{manager_name}} for the week of {{week_date}}. Include the following key accomplishments and updates: {{bullet_points}}. Also, include a section for blockers, even if none exist. Sign the email with {{your_name}}.

bullet_points.description: Key accomplishments and updates to include in the email.

week_date.description: The week date to reference in the email subject.

manager_name.description: The name of the manager to whom the email is addressed.

your_name.description: The name of the sender of the email.

input.bullet_points: finished auth module, fixed 3 bugs in payment flow, unblocked the mobile team on the API spec.

examples.expected_output: A formal email summarizing the accomplishments and blockers for the week of September 14, 2026, addressed to John Doe and signed by Jane Smith.

input.bullet_points: completed user testing, prepared presentation for stakeholders.

examples.expected_output: A formal email summarizing the accomplishments and blockers for the week of October 21, 2026, addressed to Alice Johnson and signed by Bob Brown.
